focus: The newsroom is publishing again after six quiet days. It had been giving up after the first story it could not read instead of trying the next one, and once that was fixed it turned out the writing service had also quietly dropped the model it was using. Both are fixed, and the site now shows how long a product link has been unverifiable and when it last definitely worked, without ever calling an unverifiable link broken.
nextStep: Confirm the newsroom keeps publishing on its own schedule without help, record which model wrote each edition, and widen the check that is meant to catch unreachable safety tests. Account verification remains on its separate approval path.

decisions.note: Expose a small deterministic mobile cohort and re-check close mix.
Refresh RUM UX ingestion before treating zero or low conversion as visitor behaviour.
Flip strict only after field p75 is sufficient and healthy.
Route top themes into feedback decision board lanes.
